contract: Open the same preloaded seekable input and enumerate tracks in stream order.

Project dvcC and dvvC mapping data to version major and minor, profile, level, RPU, EL and BL flags, base-signal compatibility and metadata compression. Compare those fields with the public DOVI configuration side data.

Compare hvcE mapping bytes with HEVC enhancement-layer configuration side data. Raw mapping descriptors and their unknown fields use the source oracle. Packet addition selection is compared by mkv-side-data.

open_deviations.reading: An hvcE mapping whose record is too short is kept as written (policy for invalid optional track metadata)
open_deviations.clause: RFC 9559 section 5.1.4.1.17.4: BlockAddIDExtraData is binary data the BlockAddIDType uses; for hvcE it is an HEVC decoder configuration record (ISO/IEC 14496-15 section 8.3.3.1), which five bytes cannot hold. The Matroska reader opens the track and reports a mapping as written, as it does for an out-of-range BlockAddIDValue.
open_deviations.candidate: Opens the track with the mapping's five bytes (short), unvalidated.
open_deviations.reference: Refuses the whole input at open because the embedded configuration record is too short.
